chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who died, and some of his heirs acknowledged a debt to a man, he (the Imam) said: 'That binds him in his share.'
ai.seo_question: How is a debt handled if only some heirs acknowledge it after the deceased's death?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of individual liability in inheritance law, ensuring that a voluntary acknowledgment of debt by one heir does not unjustly burden the others. This ruling protects the financial rights of co-heirs while encouraging transparency in settling the deceased's obligations, a key concern in Shia jurisprudence regarding estate distribution.
